'''Helgred''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Helgred liked the [[Mk 45 Protective Vest]] because it had pockets, and made a good tactical harness.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
